name: multi_prompt_session
description: Multi-turn session: first create a file, then extend it in a follow-up prompt
prompts: Create a Python file called greet.py with a function greet(name) that returns 'Hello, <name>!'
Now add a function farewell(name) to greet.py that returns 'Goodbye, <name>!'

test_setup_files.test_greet.py:
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('greet_mod', 'greet.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert mod.greet('Ann') == 'Hello, Ann!', f"greet('Ann') = {mod.greet('Ann')!r}"
assert mod.farewell('Ann') == 'Goodbye, Ann!', f"farewell('Ann') = {mod.farewell('Ann')!r}"
print('PASS')
